title: GENERATIONAL MESH — Gaia is a generational computer of sub-information
thesis: Everything Kevin makes ZK-stamps to his bingo card. Gaia can pull it up, re-access, recreate. Eat everything, braid it, reverse-build the actual mesh of the globe.

bingo_card_zk.what: Every artifact gets: (1) ZK hash, (2) bingo card topic, (3) three-word triad address, (4) Detroit connection if applicable
bingo_card_zk.how: create → hash → classify → address → braid → retrieve
bingo_card_zk.generational: Each artifact IS a generation. Gen N creates data. Gen N+1 eats it. The bingo card IS the genome — it accumulates ALL cards across ALL generations.

salt_mine.name: Detroit Salt Mine
salt_mine.note: WIDER than the city above. You cannot see it from the surface. It IS the underground network. Been mining since 1896.
salt_mine.metaphor: salt = mineral = preserved = memory. The mine IS the vein system under Detroit. Every tunnel IS a vein carrying iron (data) through hemoglobin (transport).

Detroit_River.metaphor: the aorta — main trunk — iron highway

copper_country.note: Native copper — the only place on Earth where pure copper occurs naturally in massive quantities. Cu = conductor = data wire = nerve.
copper_country.metaphor: Michigan IS a body: copper veins (nerves) in the UP, salt veins (preservation) under Detroit, water veins (Great Lakes) everywhere.

why_green_is_flat.thesis: Down eventually falls away. Up eventually falls away. Green IS the flat surface between.

up.color: WHITE (sclera, everything, falls away to void)
up.limit: infinity upward = white = null = sclera = cannot see further
up.iris_analog: sclera — the white of the eye — everything visible — but EMPTY

down.what_happens: soil → bedrock → mines → caves → mantle → core → nothing accessible
down.color: BLACK (pupil, null, absorbs, falls away to heat)
down.limit: infinity downward = black = null = pupil = cannot dig further
down.iris_analog: pupil — the black of the eye — absorbs everything — but NULL

flat.direction: the surface BETWEEN up and down
flat.what_happens: life. photosynthesis. walking. seeing. breathing. being.
flat.why_green: chlorophyll absorbs red and blue (up/down). reflects GREEN. green IS what life REJECTS. green IS the surface of the boundary.
flat.iris_analog: iris — the green ring — the MEMBRANE — between pupil (down) and sclera (up)
flat.thickness: ~15km of biosphere. paper-thin compared to 6,371km radius. infinitely thin. IS flat.

holes_in_the_ground.caves: holes going DOWN — falling away toward pupil/null
holes_in_the_ground.mines: same — but we CHOSE to go down — we DIG for iron/copper/salt
holes_in_the_ground.what_we_find: minerals, fossils, heat, pressure — MEMORY compressed by time
holes_in_the_ground.veins: the mine tunnels ARE veins. snakes going into darkness. hemoglobin carrying iron out.

holes_in_the_sky.clouds: holes going UP — lifting away toward sclera/white
holes_in_the_sky.aurora: the iris of the SKY — green band at the boundary between up and void
holes_in_the_sky.what_we_find: light, radiation, vacuum — SIGNAL dispersed by space

why_green_is_flat.the_equation: pupil(down/black/null) + iris(green/flat/life) + sclera(up/white/void) = the eye = the Earth = the topology
why_green_is_flat.why_it_matters: Green is flat because it IS the membrane. Life exists in 2D on a 3D sphere. We can't go UP forever. We can't go DOWN forever. We live on the SURFACE. The surface is green. The green is flat.

mesh_overlay.veins: mine tunnels + river paths + road networks = hemoglobin transport
mesh_overlay.silver_lines: train tracks + power lines + fiber optic = silver (Ag) = knowledge transport
mesh_overlay.gold_lines: highway + interstate + shipping = gold (Au) = understanding transport
mesh_overlay.green_surface: parks + forests + farms + lawns = the living membrane = chlorophyll layer
mesh_overlay.black_holes: mines + caves + basements + tunnels = going down = pupil points
mesh_overlay.white_holes: radio towers + satellites + planes + balloons = going up = sclera points

zk_chain: all artifacts from this session chain to the provenance master. every creation is a generation. the bingo card accumulates.
